title: Hepatotoxicity of 8:2 Polyfluoroalkyl Phosphate Diesters Exposure via JAK2/STAT3 Pathway Activation and M1 Macrophage Polarization in Mice.
authors: Liu, Yongjie; Jiao, Xianting; Meng, Xi; Guo, Yue; Pan, Yitao; Dong, Chenyin; Yu, Yunjiang; Zhang, Jun
one_liner_zh: 该文研究8:2 diPAP暴露通过JAK2/STAT3通路和M1巨噬细胞极化致小鼠肝毒性，虽含分子对接但对象为小分子-蛋白，非蛋白质-DNA互作，且无AI/物理模拟方法，与本课题关联极弱。
abstract: Polyfluoroalkyl phosphate esters (PAPs) are widely used as substitutes for legacy perfluoroalkyl and polyfluoroalkyl substances (PFAS), contributing a non-negligible environmental burden. However, their in vivo hepatotoxicity and underlying mechanisms remain poorly understood. We developed a mouse model to assess the hepatotoxic effects and mechanisms of 8:2 polyfluoroalkyl phosphate diesters (8:2 diPAP). Exposure to 8:2 diPAP at doses of 0.5, 5, and 50 mg/kg resulted in hepatocyte damage and elevated serum levels of total bilirubin. Albumin, alanine transaminase, and aspartate aminotransferase were significantly elevated in the 50 mg/kg 8:2 diPAP group. Expressions of M1-type macrophage markers and the proportion of M1 macrophages were significantly increased in the liver under 8:2 diPAP exposure. Janus kinase/signal transducer and activator of transcription (JAK/STAT) signaling were significantly enriched under 8:2 diPAP exposure. Molecular docking revealed direct 8:2 diPAP-JAK2 binding, and Western blot analysis showed decreased hepatic Jak2 expression in exposed mice. Increased Stat3 phosphorylation and reduced Socs3 expression in the exposed livers suggested that 8:2 diPAP activates the Stat3 pathway by inhibiting Socs3, thereby promoting M1 macrophage polarization. Our findings demonstrate that 8:2 diPAP exposure induces liver injury by driving M1 macrophage polarization in mice, providing further insight into the health effects and risk assessment of PAPs.
abstract_zh: 多氟烷基磷酸酯（PAPs）被广泛用作传统全氟烷基和多氟烷基物质（PFAS）的替代品，造成了不可忽视的环境负担。然而，其体内肝毒性及潜在机制仍知之甚少。我们建立了一个小鼠模型，以评估8:2多氟烷基磷酸二酯（8:2 diPAP）的肝毒性效应及其机制。暴露于0.5、5和50 mg/kg剂量的8:2 diPAP导致肝细胞损伤和血清总胆红素水平升高。在50 mg/kg 8:2 diPAP组中，白蛋白、丙氨酸转氨酶和天冬氨酸转氨酶显著升高。在8:2 diPAP暴露下，肝脏中M1型巨噬细胞标志物的表达及M1巨噬细胞比例显著增加。Janus激酶/信号转导与转录激活因子（JAK/STAT）信号通路在8:2 diPAP暴露下显著富集。分子对接揭示了8:2 diPAP与JAK2的直接结合，Western blot分析显示暴露小鼠肝脏中Jak2表达降低。暴露肝脏中Stat3磷酸化增加和Socs3表达减少表明，8:2 diPAP通过抑制Socs3激活Stat3通路，从而促进M1巨噬细胞极化。我们的研究结果表明，8:2 diPAP暴露通过驱动小鼠M1巨噬细胞极化诱导肝损伤，为PAPs的健康效应和风险评估提供了进一步见解。
